fields.title: New Line shows the fields Title and Description with grey question prompts
fields.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an open work order, work order 1, that is not invoiced, so you can add a line to it.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
fields.custom_steps:
1. Click New Line.
  2. Click the Description box.
  3. Type "excessive play".
  4. Click the Title box.
  5. Type "Replace tie rod".
fields.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens over work order 1, with the cursor already in the first field.
  • The first field is labeled exactly "Title", with no asterisk, and the label sits at the top of the box.
  • The grey prompt "What are you doing?" shows inside the Title box, under the label.
  • The second field is labeled exactly "Description", with the label at the top of the box.
  • The grey prompt "Why are you doing it?" shows inside the Description box, under the label.

Step 2:

  • The Description label stays at the top of the box.
  • The grey prompt "Why are you doing it?" still shows, because the box is empty.

Step 3:

  • The prompt "Why are you doing it?" is gone and only "excessive play" shows in the box.
  • The label still reads "Description", at the top of the box.

Step 4:

  • The Title label stays at the top of the box.
  • The grey prompt "What are you doing?" still shows, because the box is empty.

Step 5:

  • The prompt "What are you doing?" is gone and only "Replace tie rod" shows in the box.
  • The label still reads "Title", at the top of the box.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog)

  • S1-R1: “The first field is labeled exactly "Title", with no asterisk.”
  • S1-R2: “The second field is labeled exactly "Description".”
  • S1-R3: “The Title box carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box carries "Why are you doing it?". Placeholder text shows while the box is empty and disappears as soon as there is a value. This is the one layout change in the dialog.”

fields.title: Design: ShopCoach table rows keep their size when a cell shows its prompt
fields.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an open work order, work order 1, that is not invoiced, for an asset with its year, make and model filled in, so ShopCoach can suggest lines for it.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
fields.custom_steps:
1. Type "brakes grinding" in the ShopCoach Line Builder box on work order 1's Lines tab.
  2. Click Build Lines.
  3. Take a screenshot of the suggested lines table.
  4. Click the description cell of the first suggested line.
  5. Delete all the text in the Description editor.
  6. Click outside the table.
  7. Take a second screenshot of the table.
fields.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "brakes grinding" shows in the ShopCoach Line Builder box of work order 1.

Step 2:

  • Suggested lines appear in a table, each with a title and a description.
  • The table shows at least two suggested lines.

Step 3:

  • The first screenshot is saved, with every row of the table in it.

Step 4:

  • An editor labeled "Description" opens on the description.

Step 5:

  • The grey prompt "Why are you doing it?" shows in the empty editor.

Step 6:

  • The emptied cell reads "Why are you doing it?", with only the first W a capital.

Step 7:

  • Side by side, the two screenshots show the same row heights and the same column widths: the emptied cell's row is no taller or shorter than before, and the other cells sit where they were.

What you should see today: after you click Build Lines, nothing appears: no suggested lines, no error message, and the builder never shows that it has finished (seen on staging; whether the QA build sv10130 has the same fault is not known). This is a known problem and it is already reported — see https://shopview.atlassian.net/browse/SV-11850 (found on staging on 27 Oct 2026).

· If you see exactly that, mark this test FAILED and do not raise anything new.

· If it fails in a DIFFERENT way from what is described above, that is a NEW problem — please report it.

· If it PASSES, the fix has shipped: report it so the ticket can be closed and this note removed.
